structural_firewall.claim_boundary: The embedding and its deletion compatibility are exact constructions. The atom-basis pattern is only a finite exact audit at w<=6,n<=6 until a general cell-parity proof and explicit all-q factor cores are supplied. No arbitrary-width theorem is claimed.

structural_firewall.embedding: Restrict the checkerboard-boundary rotation of the next-even box to the requested n x w x w vertices; cap the ribbon-graph boundary faces.
structural_firewall.observed_general_pattern: For w=2..6 and n=2..6, filtration-adapted symplectic normalization leaves only a-modes nonexact.
